Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined part of the given sentence.

Dogs are known for possession of the quality of being faithful.
questions.solution: D) Fidelity (noun) - Faithfulness to a person, cause, or belief, demonstrated by continuing loyalty and support. वफादारी

questions.question: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word .
questions.questionHtml: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: B) The incorrectly spelled word is 'Monologe'. The correct spelling is 'Monologue' which means “a long speech by one actor in a play or movie, or as part of a theatrical or broadcast program” एक अभिनेता द्वारा नाटक या फिल्म में, या थियेटरिकल या प्रसारण कार्यक्रम के हिस्से के रूप में एक लंबी भाषण.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'. He was so curious that he rose many_questions in the meeting.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.

He was so curious that he rose many_questions in the meeting.

options.html: that he raised many questions
that he rose much questions
that he aroused many questions

questions.solution: 'that he raised many questions' will be selected because here the correct form of "rise" is "raise" which means "to pose questions," whereas "rise" means "to ascend"; Like— The sun rises in the east.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A building containing interesting, rare, and old objects
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A building containing interesting, rare, and old objects
questions.solution: B) Museum (noun) – A building in which objects of historical, scientific, artistic, or cultural interest are stored and exhibited. संग्रहालय

questions.question: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order. A) In a small town in England, there lived a poor little girl. B) She was very excited but her right shoe was worn out. C) So, she went to a cobbler to get it mended. D) Her friend invited her to come to her birthday party.
questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.

A) In a small town in England, there lived a poor little girl.

B) She was very excited but her right shoe was worn out.

C) So, she went to a cobbler to get it mended.

D) Her friend invited her to come to her birthday party.
questions.solution: C) ADBC

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Rome grew from a small town on the Tiber River in central Italy into a _______ empire that ultimately embraced England.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Rome grew from a small town on the Tiber River in central Italy into a _______ empire that ultimately embraced England.
questions.solution: A) Vast' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि यह शब्द विस्तार की अधिकता और बड़ापन को दर्शाता है। "Rome grew from a small town" इस संदर्भ में, हम बात कर रहे हैं कि कैसे रोम एक छोटे से शहर से एक बड़ी साम्राज्य में बदल गया। "Vast" उस साम्राज्य के विशाल विस्तार को सबसे अच्छा प्रकट करता है। इसलिए, "vast" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. To drag one’s feet
questions.questionHtml:

To drag one’s feet

To delay taking a decision
To pull someone’s legs

questions.solution: B) To drag one’s feet (idiom) – To delay taking a decision किसी निर्णय को लेने में देरी करना

questions.solution: D) The parcel was not delivered by the courier boy.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank . The weather report shows the _____ of rainfall.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The weather report shows the _____ of rainfall.
questions.solution: D) 'Probability' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि मौसम की रिपोर्ट में वर्षा की संभावना की चर्चा की जाती है। "The weather report shows the _____ of rainfall." इस वाक्य में वर्षा की संभावित होने की स्थिति को दर्शाया जा रहा है। इसलिए, "probability" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

questions.question: Select the best express synonym of the highlighted word The company decided to leverage its vast user data to improve targeted advertising strategies.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM to replace the italicised word. There is a/an abundance of fertile soil and magnificent grazing land.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM to replace the italicised word.

There is a/an abundance of fertile soil and magnificent grazing land.
questions.solution: A) 'Dearth' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि "dearth" का अर्थ होता है 'कमी' या 'अभाव', जो "abundance" का विपरीत है। दिए गए वाक्य में, जिस शब्द का अर्थ 'प्रचुरता' या 'अधिक मात्रा' हो, उसका विपरीत 'dearth' होगा।

I try to avoid travel in the rush hour
questions.solution: A) travel in' के बदले 'travelling in' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'avoid' के साथ gerund form का प्रयोग होता है; जैसे— He avoids going to crowded places.

questions.question: In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error. The promoters of Med Hospitals has agreed to sell their business to Pal Hospitals.
questions.questionHtml:
In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.

The promoters of Med Hospitals has agreed to sell their business to Pal Hospitals.

options.html: to sell their business
med Hospitals has agreed

questions.solution: C) has agreed’ के बदले ‘have agreed’ का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि ‘The promoters’ एक plural subject है और plural subject के साथ verb भी plural में होता हैं; जैसे— The promoters of Med Hospitals have agreed to sell their business to Pal Hospitals.

questions.question: In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error. I visited my friend to whom I had made an appointment.
questions.questionHtml:
In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.

I visited my friend to whom I had made an appointment.

options.html: I visited my friend

questions.solution: C) 'to whom' के बदले 'with whom' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि appointment के लिए 'with' preposition का प्रयोग होता है; जैसे— I made an appointment with my friend.
